return client.sql(INSERT)
        .bind("actor", Parameters.in(R2dbcType.VARCHAR, entry.actor()))
        .bind("action", Parameters.in(R2dbcType.VARCHAR, entry.action()))
        .bind("outcome", Parameters.in(R2dbcType.VARCHAR, entry.outcome()))
        .bind("occurredAt", entry.timestamp().atOffset(ZoneOffset.UTC))
        .bind("correlationId", Parameters.in(R2dbcType.VARCHAR, entry.correlationId()))
        .then();
members: private static final String INSERT = "INSERT INTO audit_trail (actor, action, outcome, occurred_at, correlation_id) VALUES (:actor, :action, :outcome, :occurredAt, :correlationId)"
